key.name: favorites
key.description: Contacts assigned to speed dial slots, stored as a JSON list.

key.name: muted-conversations
key.description: Conversation ids that never raise a notification, stored as a JSON list.

key.name: delivery-reports
key.description: Ask the network to confirm when sent SMS and MMS messages reach the recipient.

key.name: own-number
key.description: The user's own phone number.

key.name: default-country-code
key.description: Default country code for formatting numbers without international prefix.

key.name: reject-call-message
key.description: Message to send when rejecting a call.

key.name: reject-call-messages
key.description: JSON list of messages to choose from when rejecting a call.

key.name: call-volume-levels
key.description: JSON map of output route to base volume percent applied when a call connects.

key.name: notification-override-repeated-calls-bypass
key.description: Whether repeated calls bypass Do Not Disturb.

key.name: ringback-enabled
key.description: Whether custom ringback is enabled.

key.name: ringback-custom-file
key.description: Path to custom ringback file.

key.name: emergency-numbers
key.description: JSON serialized array of configured emergency numbers.

key.name: trusted-sms-location-request
key.description: JSON serialized array of trusted contacts for location requests.

key.name: trusted-sms-silent-callback
key.description: JSON serialized array of trusted contacts for silent callbacks.

key.name: trusted-sms-relay
key.description: JSON serialized array of trusted contacts for SMS relay.

key.name: trusted-sms-ssh-access
key.description: JSON serialized array of trusted contacts for tmate ssh access.

key.name: trusted-sms-lock-device
key.description: JSON serialized array of trusted contacts for device locking.

key.name: notification-override-dnd-bypass-contacts
key.description: JSON serialized array of priority contacts.

key.name: notification-override-sms-custom-tone-contacts
key.description: JSON serialized array of SMS custom tones per contact.

key.name: notification-override-call-custom-contacts
key.description: JSON serialized array of ring custom tones per contact.

key.name: address-book-sources
key.description: JSON serialized array of configured address book sources.

key.name: duplicate-resolver-enabled
key.description: Whether to show the duplicate contacts resolution banner.

key.name: unknown-callers
key.description: Action to take for unknown callers: none, block, hide, silence.

key.name: unknown-callers-search
key.description: Show search button for unknown callers.

key.name: unknown-callers-engine
key.description: Search engine to use for unknown callers.

key.name: unknown-callers-custom-url
key.description: Custom URL for unknown callers search.

key.name: trusted-sms-location-request-enabled
key.description: Whether the feature Location Requests is enabled. Note: It also requires a trusted contact, secret, and TOTP setup to work.

key.name: trusted-sms-silent-callback-enabled
key.description: Whether the feature Trusted Callback is enabled. Note: It also requires a trusted contact, secret, and TOTP setup to work.

key.name: trusted-sms-relay-enabled
key.description: Whether the feature SMS Relay is enabled. Note: It also requires a trusted contact, secret, and TOTP setup to work.

key.name: trusted-sms-ssh-access-enabled
key.description: Whether the feature SMS tmate is enabled. Note: It also requires a trusted contact, secret, and TOTP setup to work.

key.name: trusted-sms-lock-device-enabled
key.description: Whether the feature Lock Device is enabled. Note: It also requires a trusted contact, secret, and TOTP setup to work.

key.name: voicemail-number
key.description: Custom voicemail mailbox number; empty uses the number provisioned on the SIM.

key.name: automatic-modem-recovery
key.description: Whether the app silently restarts the modem stack (never the reboot) when the modem stops responding, instead of showing the Modem Recovery screen.

key.name: mms-size-limit
key.description: Maximum total MMS attachment size in kilobytes.
